source_snapshot.items: Upgrade and Downgrade PSU firmware by Redfish
source_snapshot.procedure: Power off the system and follow the Delta PSU Update Instruction SOP to update PSU firmware.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 60 attended/60 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies Redfish flash, user image, host-off and task/version evidence but does not separate both directions or fully bind target/recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires exact Delta PSU/images/SOP, redundancy, per-direction one-shot authorization, activation and recovery.

old_problem: The exact PSU, paired images, Delta SOP endpoint/payload, activation semantics and recovery were missing. The title requires both upgrade and downgrade, which cannot be collapsed into one generic update or blind retry.
disposition_reason: ED-07/08/12/15/20 require retaining real Flash, before/after active-version proof, separate Upgrade/Downgrade coverage and one-shot authorization. Exact bay/image/SOP/activation values are project prerequisites, so the review can resolve as two immutable, independently approved transactions without inventing an endpoint or executing a flash.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2231, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2232 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00014-V001 / 465274543f334321 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind SUT/BMC and exact PSU bay/model/PN/serial/feed/redundancy plus current version before either direction.
Validate the Delta SOP revision, exact Redfish endpoint/payload/task schema, signed image hash/signature, compatibility and allowed source-target pair.
Upgrade and Downgrade are separate transactions with separate approval, baseline, terminal task, activation, active-version, PSU health/redundancy and recovery evidence.
Drain workloads and prove the required host-OFF state before each flash; OFF does not authorize AC removal or any unspecified cycle.
Never interrupt, parallelize or automatically retry an indeterminate/failed task; preserve task and SEL/power/thermal evidence.
Restore the signed final firmware and host/power state only through separately authorized SOP steps.
No power-off, Redfish request, firmware Flash, activation/cycle, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Delta PSU Redfish firmware Upgrade and Downgrade as separate one-shot transactions
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate independently that the intended Delta PSU can be upgraded and downgraded through the approved Redfish SOP while the host is off, with correct active version, PSU health/redundancy and final restoration.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC and PSU bay/model/PN/serial/feed/redundancy identity
Delta PSU Update Instruction revision and exact Redfish payload/task/activation schema
Signed compatible Upgrade and Downgrade images, source/target/final versions and hashes
Host-off/drain plan, per-direction authorization, activation requirements and rollback/vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: Run Upgrade and Downgrade only as separately authorized transactions. For each: prove exact PSU/image compatibility and host OFF, submit the immutable Delta-SOP Redfish payload once, monitor to the documented terminal state without interruption, perform only the approved activation, verify active target version and PSU/redundancy health, preserve logs, and recover/restore the signed final state without automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: Each direction independently reaches its signed active target version on the correct PSU with a successful terminal Redfish task, healthy PSU/redundancy and no unexpected BMC/power/thermal event; the approved final firmware and host/power state are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires separate complete Upgrade and Downgrade evidence, exact target/image identity, before/after active version, terminal task and health/redundancy proof. Upload alone, staged-only version, one direction standing for both, unexpected cycle, failed/indeterminate task or failed recovery is not PASS. Missing artifacts blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, image compatibility/signature/hash, SOP payload, redundancy, host-off plan, activation and recovery are signed.
Separate one-shot authorization for Upgrade, Downgrade and any activation/reset/AC operation.
No interruption, parallel flash or automatic retry.
Stop on identity/hash mismatch, loss of redundancy/access, indeterminate task, PSU fault or unexpected power/thermal event.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/PSU bay/model/serial/feed identity
SOP plus immutable Upgrade/Downgrade image version/hash/signature/compatibility
Per-direction host-OFF authorization and before/staged/active/post version inventory
Secret-redacted Redfish request metadata and complete task timeline/terminal state
Per-direction PSU health/redundancy, SEL/power/thermal evidence and final restored state
test_case.recovery: On failed or indeterminate task, do not retry or cycle automatically. Preserve evidence and use the Delta/vendor-approved rollback, reflash or module-recovery procedure through the independent power path; verify redundancy before any later direction.

source_conflict.reason: The title's Upgrade and Downgrade scope is preserved as two transactions; the SOP-based procedure can supply both without contradiction.

blocked.reason: The firmware lifecycle and Redfish mechanism are identifiable; exact artifacts, payloads and recovery are expected project prerequisites.
